name: xpensego
description: Trustworthy personal finance capture and review across web and messaging surfaces.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run build:cloudflare
scripts.format: prettier --write .github apps packages scripts docs/adr compose.yaml package.json tsconfig.json turbo.json oxlint.json prettier.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .github apps packages scripts docs/adr compose.yaml package.json tsconfig.json turbo.json oxlint.json prettier.config.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run types:api && oxlint --deny-warnings --type-aware --type-check apps packages scripts
scripts.test: npm run test:policy && turbo run test --cache-dir=node_modules/.cache/turbo
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration --workspace=@xpensego/adapters && npm run test:integration --workspace=@xpensego/api
